messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

A student was shown this C code and question.

Code:
int shield = 10;
if (shield < 0); fire();

Question: Does it fire?
The student answered: yes

The student understands this correctly: A `;` right after the if/for/while header is an empty body; the next statement is not part of it.

Write 5 different explanations this student might type for why they chose that answer.
Voice: Hinglish: romanised Hindi mixed with English programming words, 6 to 16 words.

Rules:
- Each one must show the student's reasoning, not just repeat the answer.
- Write as the student, in the first person or with no subject. Do not judge the answer or say it is wrong.
- Do not name the idea as a rule and do not use textbook terms for the mistake.
- Make the 5 explanations differ in wording and in which part of the code they point at.

Return JSON: {"sentences": ["...", "..."]}

content: {"sentences": ["Dekha ki if ke baad semicolon hai, matlab uska body khali hai, phir fire alag statement hai.", "shield 10 hai toh condition false, lekin semicolon ne if ko khatam kar diya, isliye fire hoga.", "Semicolon if header ke turant baad, toh fire wala statement if ke andar nahi aata.", "Fire alag se likha hai after semicolon, toh wo hamesha chalega.", "Condition fail hui lekin semicolon ke wajah se fire statement if se bahar hai."]}

sentences: Dekha ki if ke baad semicolon hai, matlab uska body khali hai, phir fire alag statement hai.
shield 10 hai toh condition false, lekin semicolon ne if ko khatam kar diya, isliye fire hoga.
Semicolon if header ke turant baad, toh fire wala statement if ke andar nahi aata.
Fire alag se likha hai after semicolon, toh wo hamesha chalega.
Condition fail hui lekin semicolon ke wajah se fire statement if se bahar hai.
